description: This is a JUnit test class for testing the JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino's mapping functions in the Eclipse Ditto project. It initializes various mapping scripts and tests incoming and outgoing message mappings with different scenarios including default, plain text, binary, with status, and with extra data. The class checks the correctness of the mapping logic between external messages and Ditto internal representations.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperRhinoTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino, testing various message mappings.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes multiple JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino instances with different scripts and configurations before running tests.

methods.name: testNoopJavascriptIncomingMapping
methods.description: Tests that a NOOP incoming mapping script correctly returns the original message payload.

methods.name: testNoopJavascriptOutgoingMapping
methods.description: Tests that a NOOP outgoing mapping script correctly wraps the internal object into an ExternalMessage.

methods.name: testDefaultJavascriptOutgoingMapping
methods.description: Tests default outgoing mapping script which serializes internal objects into JSON.

methods.name: testDefaultJavascriptOutgoingMappingWithStatus
methods.description: Tests outgoing mapping with status code included in the message.

methods.name: testDefaultJavascriptOutgoingMappingWithStatusAndExtra
methods.description: Tests outgoing mapping with both status code and extra enriched attributes.

methods.name: testPlainJavascriptIncomingMapping
methods.description: Tests plain text incoming message parsing into internal Adaptable object.

methods.name: testPlainJavascriptIncomingMappingWithStatus
methods.description: Tests incoming message mapping with status code representation.

methods.name: testPlainJavascriptIncomingMappingWithStatusAndExtra
methods.description: Tests incoming message with status and extra attributes.

methods.name: testPlainJavascriptOutgoingMapping
methods.description: Tests outgoing message generation for a created object.

methods.name: testEmptyJavascriptIncomingMapping
methods.description: Ensures that an empty incoming message produces no Adaptable objects.

methods.name: testEmptyJavascriptOutgoingMapping
methods.description: Checks that mapping an object yields no outgoing message when configured as empty.

methods.name: testBinaryJavascriptIncomingMapping
methods.description: Tests incoming binary message processing into internal Adaptable object.

methods.name: testBinaryJavascriptOutgoingMapping
methods.description: Verifies that outgoing binary mapping produces correct byte payloads.

methods.name: byteBuffer2String
methods.description: Utility method to convert ByteBuffer content to String for testing and validation purpose.
